title: Michael driven back to base by a sergeant after the incident
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Next thing I know I was riding back with somebody. I was riding back with sergeant.

plain: Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran who served at the missile fields around Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says that after the strange incident he lived through there in 1977, his next memory is of being driven back to base. He tells Michels, "Next thing I know I was riding back with somebody. I was riding back with sergeant," a jump in memory that, if true, points to time he cannot account for.
